s: 這個牌子的衛生紙打八折，很多人搶著購買。
Zhè ge páizi de wèishēngzhǐ dǎ bā zhé, hěn duō rén qiǎng zhe gòumǎi.
This brand of toilet paper is 20% off; many people are rushing to buy it.
按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.
